questions.text: It is 2026-11-09 and this lost 1R: Brent went through 98.0 first, which random entries with your target and stop did 38.3% of the time. What happened? Name at least one reason that is a thesis error, not luck.

The idea's source is consensus, yet managed money is only at the 17.0th percentile on your side: if this is the consensus view, who is still left to buy, and what is your own edge beyond agreeing with the crowd?
